MIN_2 now exempts ore from the ORDER-size cap only (lane capacity units_per_cycle is unchanged: ore lanes are still limited by cargo). Wanted wider?
MIL_1 upkeep still cuts maintenance only, not trip cost (from skills-core).
handoff: Both unwired effects are now real. MIN_2 ore_free_slots: RouteEngine.local_amount(good) returns an uncapped amount for ore when MIN_2 is learned, so ore Buy/Sell orders (incl. stop sales) are limited only by storage room, cash and stock (40 -> uncapped). LUX_4 stock_protect: redefined from 'planet closes' (nothing ever destroys stock then) to the one real stock loss, an asteroid cut of a planet storage: Storage.cut_capacity no longer trims Luxury stock when LUX_4 is learned (Storage.space now floors at 0). skills.json 'on' = storage_cut; SK_LUX_4_PLAIN and SK_MIN_2_PLAIN rewritten, story rebuilt. No new balance keys. tools/sim.py no longer models skills (header says so; C1/B1 are free unlock flags) and runs, plain and --settle. Tests TOTAL pass=1149 fail=0, two new tests.

previously_not_wired.ore_free_slots: WIRED, redefined narrowly: ore orders ignore the order-size cap (no shared cargo slot rule exists, so lane capacity is untouched).
previously_not_wired.stock_protect: WIRED, redefined: protects Luxury stock from asteroid storage cuts (the only thing that destroys stored stock). Not tied to planet closure because closure never touches stock.
previously_not_wired.reveal_prices: NOT WIRED beyond on/off: the cycles value is read but the panel always shows 1 cycle ahead.
previously_not_wired.event_warning: NOT WIRED beyond on/off: forecast is always 1 cycle ahead.
